worldcombat.skill.submission.summary: Grab and throw a target to knock it down, taking recoil damage. Larger targets are harder to throw.
worldcombat.skill.submission.description: The slam deals %1$s contact damage, lunging up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block grab radius.
After the grab a %1$s s window passes before the dive; the target is pinned for %2$s s and hurled %3$s blocks. A bulkier target takes less slam damage and is pinned for less time.
On a hit the user takes %1$s%% of the actual damage as recoil; the lunge and landing kick up %2$s dust motes.
worldcombat.skill.submission.pin.on: Pinning form: a lighter slam and less recoil, but the target is held down much longer - for control and team play.
worldcombat.skill.submission.pin.off: Throwing form: a heavier slam, a wider throw and more recoil, but the target is up again quickly.
worldcombat.skill.submission.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.submission.growth.0: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.submission.growth.1: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s and the pin lasts %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.submission.use.0: Grab and pin a target in your face to open a window for allies
worldcombat.skill.submission.use.1: Interrupt a target that is about to act
worldcombat.skill.submission.use.2: Nail a target down with the pin, taking the recoil yourself
